items.title: Applied Materials (AMAT) Plans $5 Billion India Semiconductor Research Park
items.summary: Applied Materials (NasdaqGS:AMAT) plans to invest US$5b to build a semiconductor research park in India on a 140 acre site. The project is intended to expand the firm’s research and development presence and deepen India’s role in the semiconductor supply chain. Management is positioning the India research park as part of a wider push to integrate the country into Applied Materials’ global operations.
